summary: iOS: alerts show in each agent's conversation, answerable there; the phone counts alerts, and a compacting seat reads as compacting

replay.detail: Phone app change only; no replay change.

compatibility.detail: No client protocol change: the phone reads the existing alert, conversation_id and activity fields and keeps the attention wire names, so older and newer builds work against the same daemons.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; a new phone build is installed by the person.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
